We're creating a new role in Product Marketing to own how we teach customers and our own teams how CloudTalk works. We're looking for a product educator who can build systems: someone who knows how to teach, and uses AI and automation to do it at the pace we ship.

CloudTalk ships more than 100 releases a quarter. Keeping documentation, guides and in-app help in step with that pace by hand doesn't scale, so this role is about building the systems that do it: documentation that updates as the product ships, AI that drafts and checks, and a clear view of what people need to learn. You'll put AI to work in a structured, repeatable way, decide what we teach, and keep improving the rules behind the systems so quality gets better over time.

It starts with the product. You'll know CloudTalk inside out, understand what each change means for the people using it, and decide which parts of the work AI does and which parts need you. If you get excited about product and enjoy explaining it, you'll feel at home: you'll present to customers and to our own teams, in webinars, sessions and how-tos.

We want someone who has built the workflow, not just used ChatGPT to draft content.
